shared_elements: carved or engraved surface with a figural or symbolic motif
justification: A depicts three-dimensional sculpted human/anthropomorphic heads and a crouching body with facial features and hatched surface texturing, while B is a flat slab bearing a linear engraved cross/arch motif framed by borders of alphabetic-looking incised signs. The only shared content is the presence of incised sign-like marks and some hatched linework on A's surface, which is a generic correspondence; the subject matter (sculpted figures versus a linear emblem with inscription bands) is otherwise entirely different.
